# Metadata column_for_table

```{tags} reference, query-template, metadata_primitives
```

> [Metadata](../../metadata-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Metadata queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
    column_name,
    data_type,
    is_nullable,
    column_default,
    ordinal_position
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_name = 'lineitem'
ORDER BY ordinal_position;
```
